np.random.seed(0)
Z = np.random.randint(0, 2, (50, 50))
iterations = 10

def _life_step(z):
    N = (z[0:-2, 0:-2] + z[0:-2, 1:-1] + z[0:-2, 2:] +
         z[1:-1, 0:-2]                 + z[1:-1, 2:] +
         z[2:  , 0:-2] + z[2:  , 1:-1] + z[2:  , 2:])
    birth = (N == 3) & (z[1:-1, 1:-1] == 0)
    survive = ((N == 2) | (N == 3)) & (z[1:-1, 1:-1] == 1)
    out = np.zeros_like(z)
    out[1:-1, 1:-1][birth | survive] = 1
    return out

_Z = Z.copy()
for _ in range(iterations):
    _Z = _life_step(_Z)
_expected = _Z
test_cases.expected_expr: _expected
